<function name="IsPaused" parent="timer" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Returns whenever the given timer is paused or not. (<page>timer.Pause</page>)

</description>
	<added>2026.06.25</added>
	<realm>Shared and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="identifier" type="string">Identifier of the timer. (<page>timer.Create</page>)</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Returns true if the timer is paused, false if it isn't, `nil` if it doesn't exist.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
